title: Expressive Articulate Knowledgeable tour guide 5 star
text: Tour guide was exceptional…knowledgeable about art in general , Picasso’s life, influences, friends, other artists of the times, etc.  Not too exotic or detailed, but increased my understanding.  High energy and expressive with excellent English.  Plenty to see there after the tour; nicely curated gift shop-no tourista junk.
author: davidbT4128PL

title: The Cathedral of the Sea is a place of mental rest
text: Once you read the book of the same title, you want to go and meet it, and since you are there you live the history of everything that has surrounded the city. While inside the cathedral you live in the past, its darkness, its silence, its height, the same people change.  And when you leave the neighborhood is still an adventure, you start combining history with modern, with people everywhere, with streets full of sales, but always enjoying every street every building.
author: salvadorj269

title: Read the book? Now see the locations
text: . This tour was fantastic. Our guide Laura was lovely and informative and read small passages of the book that related to what we were seeing. Highly reccomended
author: rhiannonn975

title: Recommended if you want to learn more about the book and Barcelona's history
text: We are very happy we booked this guided tour and recommend it strongly. We didn't realise we had booked a Spanish tour, but the tour guide was willing to translate to English for us. She had a lot of knowledge about the book and about Barcelona. The group was small and we were able to ask any questions we had. It was very special that we were allowed inside many of the buildings.
author: julivdb

title: A beauty
text: I transport myself to the narration of the book with the same name, very beautiful, in a very typical neighborhood of Barcelona.
author: Martemisa

title: to do it!!!!
text: It is a very interesting tour, and when we arrived at the church of the virgin of the sea we were surprised by the beautiful simplicity of its interior, and seeing the small image of the virgin on the altar closes with this story perfectly.
author: Claudita P

title: Excellent time travel led by an unbeatable guide.
text:
The guide led us through the spaces of the Cathedral of the Sea in a professional way, with historical knowledge. He explained the tour and its history in a pleasant, professional and, most importantly, from the heart. That explains why I remember everything clearly when normally in these cases after a while I no longer remember anything...!
Thanks for the experience.
author: lidia230

title: I liked it very much! Cristina, the...
text: I liked it very much! Cristina, the guide, knew a lot about the history of the city and of the book of course. By following the steps of the characters of the book you get to learn about history and social life of ancient Barcelona. Great!
author: pilital

title: Outstanding! Excellent info...
text: Outstanding! Excellent info provided. Antonia (I think that was her name), made the tour an easy path to understand the history of Catalonia, Spain. Without any doubts, I will take it again.
author: Ramona_F

title: Very interesting
text:
We found it a unique activity, full of content well transmitted by a professional with great communication skills, professionalism and knowledge.
The route has no waste, well calculated, interesting and beautiful.
One of the best experiences in Barcelona.
author: Maria R
